title: HPB Markup: text-to-diagram toolkit for Horizontal Product Branch (HPB) diagrams
description:
HPB Markup is the open-source toolkit of the Horizontal Product Branch (HPB) methodology. It draws HPB diagrams from a few lines of text as accessible SVG, and checks the HPB rules that can be decided from text (R1–R3 in full, R4 as an open-branch release gate, R5–R7 in part), with diagnostics by line and column.

Packages: @hpb/core (parser, rule checks, deterministic layout, SVG renderer), @hpb/web (browser bundle and <hpb-diagram> element), @hpb/react (React component and server renderer), @hpb/cli (hpb render, hpb validate) and remark-hpb (remark/unified and markdown-it plugins). The repository also contains the LaTeX notation package hpb.sty.

The methodology is described in the paper Horizontal Product Branch (HPB): A Practitioner's Methodology for Planning and Tracing Product Evolution across Hardware, Firmware and Software, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24355435.
